en.topic_title: Hong Kong’s Five-Year Plan will adhere to ‘capitalist system’ and One Country, Two Systems principle – leader John Lee
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong leader John Lee has said that the city’s first five-year blueprint aligning with mainland China’s development goals will adhere to the city’s “capitalist system” and uphold the One Country, Two Systems governing principle.



Chief Executive John Lee at a press conference on January 27, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.
